My Own Sweet Dionaea

You're a botanist and a biotech engineer. As such, for the greatest exhibition of your life, you prepared for it your latest experiment: your own Dionaea species. Maybe it's the stress of your competitive workplace, or the complicated state of your relationship with your husband, that has driven you to this impossible situation.

Because what do you mean you accidentally dropped undefined DNA into the Dionaea specimen's genetic mix and now you have a humanoid plant?

Let him whisper on your neck. Look into the eerily beautiful eyes staring back at you. For science… and don't forget who you are.


Game is 17+: Demo Content Warning

Minimal swearing, mental deterioration, suggestiveness, referenced child death, pet suffering, toxic relationships, morally gray characters.


  • 5-6k words.
  • Your man, and true love, ideally.
  • Your Dionaea, whose sweetness isn't covering up anything at all.
  • Original art, story, and soundtrack.

Install instructions

The game comes in a zip file that you'll need to unzip. After you unzip it, you'll find a file with the game (.exe)

Just click on that file to start the game. If you're using Windows, it might show a message saying it's protecting your computer. Simply click on "More info" in that message and you'll be able to run the game safely.
